annotations.title: Check mariner hours of rest (STCW, 46 CFR 15.1111)

description: Check work periods against STCW hours of rest (10 in any 24 hours, 77 in any 7 days, no more than two rest periods with one of 6 hours, no more than 14 hours between rests) and optionally the 12-hour towing work limit in 46 U.S.C. 8104(h). Every sliding window is checked.
